sources.coverage: Historical polity boundary reconstructions used only as secondary cartographic captures
sources.notes: Secondary reconstruction only. A captured vector may be promoted to History Core only when the exact project archive blob and dated source feature are pinned, distributed spatial controls pass, and independent A1/A2/A3 documentary evidence corroborates the represented state. It cannot by itself establish a canonical border.
